canon_summary:
James takes a brave step out of his familiar jungle home and into the vast, wildflower-filled meadow to begin his journey of exploration.
James followed a gentle splashing sound to the edge of the meadow, where he discovered a sparkling brook and dipped his toes in the cool water.
James rests by the Whispering Brook, counting his surroundings to soothe his mind. He discovers a beautiful, ice-cold blue pebble in the water and pockets it as his first keepsake.
world_lore: Sky-blue pebbles are rare, smooth stones washed down to the Whispering Brook from the distant, cold mountains.
